after.zh: 这是沿 x 方向的有符号前向差分。平坦处为 0，暗到亮为正，亮到暗为负。斜坡也有响应：每格亮度增加得一样多，差分就处处一样（图像边界除外）。差分量出局部亮度变化，可用来定位边缘。要量上下方向的变化，再做一次「下方像素 − 当前像素」。
after.en: This is the signed forward difference along x. Flat areas give zero, dark-to-bright steps give a positive response, and bright-to-dark steps give a negative one. A ramp also responds: equal increases between pixels give a constant difference away from the image boundary. These differences measure local intensity change and help locate edges. To measure changes along y, subtract the current pixel from the pixel below.

t.zh: 看一幅画，最先注意到的是轮廓：物体和背景的分界、衣服的褶、文字的笔画。在数字图里，这些地方的共同点是：亮度在很短的距离内突然变了。这就是边缘。
t.en: When you look at a picture, the first thing you notice is outlines: where an object meets the background, the folds in clothing, the strokes of letters. In a digital image, what these places have in common is that the brightness changes suddenly over a very short distance. That is an edge.

t.zh: 找边缘是视觉里最基础的一步。扫描软件靠它找纸张的四边，车道保持系统靠它找车道线。
t.en: Finding edges is the most basic step in vision. Scanning apps use it to find the four sides of a sheet of paper, and lane-keeping systems use it to find lane markings.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：每一格输出「右边邻居 − 自己」。结果可以是负数，看灰度不直观，用地形画法看起伏更清楚。
t.en: Your task in this level: for every cell, output "right neighbour − self". The result can be negative, which is hard to read in greyscale; terrain view shows the rises and falls more clearly.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：台阶，用地形画法看
caption.en: Set 1: a step, in terrain view

brief.zh: 接出「右边像素 − 当前像素」，再比较前两组台阶。亮暗对调后，边缘的输出会怎样变？
brief.en: Wire up “right pixel − current pixel,” then compare the first two steps. What happens to the edge response when light and dark swap?
